claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings (PEEP 5, PCV 20, target tidal volume 6-8 mL/kg PBW) and monitor peak/plateau pressures.
Reassess and manage severe shock with ongoing vasopressor support (phenylephrine and epinephrine drips) and frequent hemodynamic monitoring.
Trend liver enzymes (AST/ALT >6000, INR 2-3, fibrinogen 46) and coagulation parameters; monitor for acute liver failure and bleeding.
Monitor and correct metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 15-19, anion gap 18-23, lactate 2.1-5.1) with serial ABGs and lactate measurements.
Manage hyperglycemia with insulin therapy and frequent glucose monitoring (fingerstick and serum glucose).
Monitor renal function (creatinine rising to 2.4, BUN 34) and urine output; avoid nephrotoxins and consider renal replacement therapy if worsening.
Replete electrolytes: magnesium (1.7-2.2), potassium (3.4-3.8), and calcium (ionized 1.03), with serial monitoring.
Continue sedation with midazolam and fentanyl drips, targeting RASS -1 to -2, and monitor for delirium (CAM-ICU positive).
Perform daily assessment of readiness for extubation and spontaneous breathing trials when clinically appropriate.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and VTE prophylaxis (pharmacologic or mechanical) while monitoring bleeding risk given coagulopathy.
